attchmntText: Reliance Communications Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Reliance Communications Limited board, chaired by Resolution Professional Mr. Anish Niranjan Nanavaty, approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company is under corporate insolvency resolution process. The board also noted a request from Reliance Innoventures Private Limited to reclassify its status from Promoter and Promoter Group to Public. Reliance Innoventures Private Limited has disposed of its entire shareholding, holding Nil shares as on September 30, 2026. This reclassification request is subject to approval by the Committee of Creditors. Statutory auditors Pathak H. D. & Associates LLP issued a limited review report highlighting inability to comment on asset valuations, interest provisions of Rs. 1,283 crore and Rs. 2,417 crore, foreign exchange variations, and other compliance issues due to the insolvency proceedings.

attchmntText: Reliance Communications Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates Disclosure under Regulation 31A of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015   Receipt of Request for Reclassification of Shareholding from  Promoter and Promoter Group  Category to  Public  Category.
voiceSummary: Reliance Communications Limited received a request on 13th November 2026 from Reliance Innoventures Private Limited to reclassify its shareholding from the Promoter and Promoter Group category to the Public category. The shareholder holds Nil equity shares, representing 0.00 percent of the total shareholding. The face value of each equity share is Rs. 5. The resolution professional, Mr. Anish Niranjan Nanavaty, is seeking necessary legal advice regarding this request. The company is currently undergoing Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. Affairs and assets are managed by the resolution professional since June 28, 2019.

attchmntText: Reliance Communications Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Reliance Communications Limited received communications from the Department of Telecommunications dated November 09, 2026, seeking partial encashment of bank guarantees. The Department directed Punjab National Bank to encash Rs. 9,72,222 against Reliance Telecom Limited for non-litigated Spectrum Usage Charges dues for Q1 of FY 2026-27. The Department also directed State Bank of India to encash Rs. 65,602 against Reliance Communications Limited for dues in Uttarakhand, Jammu & Kashmir, and Mumbai circles. The total amount sought for encashment is Rs. 26,62,824. The company is examining the financial and legal implications of these demands. This action is part of the ongoing Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process managed by Resolution Professional Mr. Anish Niranjan Nanavaty.

attchmntText: Reliance Communications Limited has informed the Exchange about Fraud/Default/Arrest
